Container.Name: Posteryard
Container.Overview: Clean, consistent posters for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, picked, rendered and kept current automatically.[br][br]Posteryard gives every movie, show, season and episode the same calm look: clean art without printed text, the title logo in one fixed spot, a soft fade, and small badges for 4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos and the streaming service. It finds the art on TMDB, checks it, renders it, uploads it and keeps it up to date. With Live TV on, it does the same for the shows and movies in the Plex or Jellyfin guide.[br][br]It starts with Dry Run on: images go to the previews folder in Data and the server is not touched. Set Dry Run to false when you like them.[br][br]For new titles right away, add the webhook http://UNRAID-IP:8098/webhook/YOUR-WEBHOOK-SECRET in Plex under Settings, Webhooks. For Jellyfin and Emby, see the README. Without it, new titles get posters within 15 minutes.
Container.Requires: A free TMDB API key and a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server.
Container.Changes:
### 0.10.0 - 2026-10-17
#### Added
- Publish the image to Docker Hub as `sandobserver/posteryard` too, with the same tags as ghcr.io.
#### Changed
- Give a Live TV title without art its channel's logo large over the logo's blurred colours, in place of the title on dark grey. - Give a Live TV block named after its channel the same card, in place of art from the channel's show with the most airtime. - List what Posteryard needs and its Live TV posters in the Unraid template. - Install Posteryard on Unraid from the Apps tab, listed in Community Applications. - Default the Unraid webhook port to 8098, as many Unraid apps already use 8000. - Restart the Unraid container after a crash. - Show the latest release notes in the Unraid template, and take its settings help from the README. - Show the settings panel's lines for the install method picked on the landing page. - Name Posteryard's version and project page in every web request, as Wikimedia asks of programs that download its logos.
#### Fixed
- Show the Posteryard icon in the Unraid Docker tab, which cannot show SVG icons. - Upload Live TV posters again at the next sweep when Plex deletes them while cleaning bundles. - Give a Plex guide title a poster when Plex returns another entry for it, such as "News" for "News at Ten".
#### Security
- Update Pillow to 13.0.0 for its JPEG decoder buffer overflow and other image decoding fixes.

Config.Name: Webhook Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI, the Plex, Jellyfin or Emby webhook and the /healthz check.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, previews and custom art. Keep this, or every image is rendered and uploaded again.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: A free key from TMDB, under Settings, API. The API Read Access Token works too.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Your Plex server's address on the network, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Not localhost. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex token. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Any long random text, such as the output of openssl rand -hex 16. It is part of the webhook address.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true saves previews and changes nothing on your server. false uploads the images and locks them.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Libraries to manage, separated by commas, named as your server shows them. Movie and TV libraries only. PLEX_LIBRARIES works too.

Config.Name: Streaming Regions
Config.Description: Countries to look up a show's streaming service in, in order. Outside the US, put yours first, such as GB,US.

Config.Name: Notify URLs
Config.Description: Where alerts go: Apprise addresses separated by spaces or commas, for Discord, Telegram, ntfy, email and about 100 more.

Config.Name: Notify Events
Config.Description: Which alerts are sent: problems, new and summary.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: A Jellyfin API key, from API Keys in the Jellyfin dashboard.

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Your Emby server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Emby API Key
Config.Description: An Emby API key, from API Keys in the Emby dashboard.

Config.Name: Maintainerr URL
Config.Description: Your Maintainerr address, for the LEAVING IN 5 DAYS countdown.

Config.Name: fanart.tv API Key
Config.Description: Your fanart.tv API key. A second art source when TMDB has nothing clean.

Config.Name: Apple TV Art
Config.Description: Use Apple TV's key art when TMDB has no textless poster.

Config.Name: Text Check
Config.Description: Check art for printed titles and skip it. false saves about 350 MB of memory on small machines, but a few posters may show the title twice.

Config.Name: Only Rating Keys
Config.Description: Limit Posteryard to a few titles, for a first test. Rating keys separated by commas. A show includes its seasons and episodes.

Config.Name: Minimum Video Badge
Config.Description: Lowest resolution that gets a badge: off, 720, 1080 or 2160.

Config.Name: Minimum HDR Badge
Config.Description: Lowest HDR format that gets a badge: off, hdr10, hdr10plus or dolbyvision.

Config.Name: Minimum Audio Badge
Config.Description: Lowest audio that gets a badge: off, 5.1, 7.1 or atmos. DTS:X counts as atmos.

Config.Name: Accessibility Badges
Config.Description: Subtitle and audio description badges on movies: any of sdh, cc and ad, separated by commas. Read from the track flags, or from track names such as "English (SDH)".

Config.Name: Status Labels
Config.Description: JUST ADDED, NEW EPISODE and NEW SEASON labels. false turns them off.

Config.Name: Episode Thumbnails
Config.Description: plain adds a light shade, titled adds the episode number and title, off gives episodes back their server thumbnails.

Config.Name: Logo Languages
Config.Description: Title logo languages in order, such as fr,en.

Config.Name: Prefer Wordmark
Config.Description: Prefer a wide logo with the name written out. false allows tall or square logos.

Config.Name: Collection Posters
Config.Description: Give every collection a poster.

Config.Name: Live TV
Config.Description: Posters for the shows and movies in the Live TV guide, on Plex and Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Service Collections
Config.Description: Keep one collection per streaming service with at least 3 shows.

Config.Name: Sweep Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes between checks for new and changed titles.

Config.Name: Daily Pass At
Config.Description: Time of the daily full pass, as HH:MM in your TZ.

Config.Name: Heartbeat URL
Config.Description: An address Posteryard calls every minute while healthy, such as an Uptime Kuma push URL.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning or error.

Config.Name: Web UI Password
Config.Description: The password for the web UI. Without it, sign in with WEBHOOK_SECRET.
